title: In Modem, there is a possible out of bounds write due to a missing bounds check. (CVE-2026-20566)
description: A vulnerability in the Modem component allows a possible out-of-bounds write due to a missing bounds check. Exploitation requires user interaction and system-level privileges. Successful exploitation could lead to a remote denial of service if a user equipment (UE) connects to a rogue base station controlled by an attacker.
